message: We all have that one friend who tends to worry a bit too much about what could happen in an emergency. 🌪️ But instead of panicking, why not equip ourselves with some practical knowledge? That's where resources like the one from Ready.gov come in handy! They offer great tips for kids on how to be safe and prepared, turning potential fears into actionable steps. It's a fantastic way to empower little ones to feel more secure in uncertain situations. What’s your go-to tip for helping kids prepare for emergencies?
